id: RF-9 (the drive-path cases hold under a perl that has Cygwin::win_to_posix_path)
note: Git Bash's perl has Cygwin::win_to_posix_path, so a drive-path root reads as /c/... there. The cases that mean macOS or Linux set STORE_TEST_OS=linux, and the ones that mean MSYS perl without that sub set STORE_TEST_NO_CYGWIN=1, which hides the real sub (STORE_TEST_CYGDRIVE still stands in for it). Here a perl first on PATH defines the sub (C: reads as $TMP/cyg/c), as on the PC, so the seams are shown on any host. Every drive path in this case reads under $TMP or is refused: nothing is written outside the case's folder.

steps.name: the perl first on PATH has Cygwin::win_to_posix_path
macOS or Linux (STORE_TEST_OS=linux): the drive-path root is root-invalid even where perl has the sub

stdout_has: ^root: handoff_root refused \(root-invalid\); copies and evidence under it are not written$

steps.name: MSYS perl without the sub (STORE_TEST_NO_CYGWIN=1): root-invalid although perl has it

stdout_has: ^root: handoff_root refused \(root-invalid\); copies and evidence under it are not written$

steps.name: MSYS perl with the sub: the drive-path root is read in its /c/ form
